changelog:
Initial release of log-analyzer.

- Analyze server logs for error patterns, IP frequency, time-based analysis, and anomaly/spike detection.
- Supports syslog and custom log files, handling both file and piped input.
- Provides options for custom error patterns, time window, and individual or combined analysis modules.
- Uses standard Linux tools (grep, awk, sort, uniq); no external dependencies.
- Includes recommendations for interpreting findings and best practices for large log files.
